decisions.notes: CWE-126 present omits __n = strlen(dest), the operation that derives a 99-byte read from the 50-byte source buffer.
CWE-126 not_observed omits __n = strlen(dest), so the target does not show why the same 99-byte read is within the fixed 100-byte source buffer.
CWE-126 present omits sVar2 = wcslen(dest), which supplies the 99-element read length applied to the shorter wide-character source.
CWE-126 not_observed omits sVar2 = wcslen(dest), so the evidence does not connect the 100-element source bound to the actual memmove length.
CWE-126 present omits __n = strlen(dest), the code-visible basis for reading 99 bytes from dataBadBuffer[50].
CWE-126 not_observed omits __n = strlen(dest), which is required to justify that dataGoodBuffer[100] covers the copy length.
